flipToBack.timing: Required singleton trigger on isTableChanged (standing state)
flipToBack.prose: Flips when (Rebels control three Lothal locations OR you occupy three Lothal locations with Phoenix Squadron characters) AND opponent controls no Lothal location.

children.req: control WITH actor, count 3: owner controls 3 Lothal locations each with a Rebel
occupy WITH actor, count 3: owner occupies 3 Lothal locations with Phoenix Squadron characters
opponent control blocker: opponent controls any Lothal location

flipToFront.timing: Required singleton trigger on isTableChanged (standing state)
flipToFront.prose: Flips back when opponent controls MORE Lothal locations than you (strict count comparison of controlled Lothal locations).

children.req: count comparison: opponent-controlled Lothal locations > owner-controlled Lothal locations
children.gameConditions: Filters.countTopLocationsOnTable(game, Filters.and(Filters.Lothal_location, Filters.controls(opponent, SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE))) > Filters.countTopLocationsOnTable(game, Filters.and(Filters.Lothal_location, Filters.controls(playerId, SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE)))

requirementSemantics: Front flip leg A is CONTROL-WITH count semantics: controlsWith(3, Lothal_location, Rebel) - three controlled Lothal locations that each also have a Rebel. Leg B is OCCUPY-WITH count semantics: occupiesWith(3, Lothal_location, Phoenix_Squadron_character) - occupation (presence) suffices, control not needed, but the occupier set must include Phoenix Squadron characters.
Front blocker is opponent CONTROL: GameConditions.controls(game, opponent, Filters.Lothal_location) with NO SpotOverride argument - any single opponent-controlled Lothal location blocks the flip.

Back flip-back is a strict COUNT COMPARISON of controlled Lothal locations (opponent > you), using Filters.controls with SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE on both sides; ties do NOT flip back.
Phoenix Squadron membership is partially objective-granted: the front's deployment-completed action adds Keyword.PHOENIX_SQUADRON to Chopper, Ezra, Hera, Kanan, Sabine, and Zeb for remainder of game.

Both sides track 'you Force drained this turn' in WhileInPlayData (front: any forceDrainCompleted by owner, front:163-165; back: forceDrainCompleted at Filters.battleground, BACK:120-122; both reset at end of each turn) - the back's drain +1 modifier reads this flag via InPlayDataEqualsCondition.
typedIdentities: Filters.Phoenix_Squadron_character (keyword granted to Filters.Chopper, Filters.Ezra, Filters.Hera, Filters.Kanan, Filters.Sabine, Filters.Zeb via KeywordModifier Keyword.PHOENIX_SQUADRON)

Filters.or(Filters.Harc, Filters.and(Filters.Jedi, Filters.except(Filters.or(Filters.Ahsoka, Filters.Kanan))), Filters.and(Filters.your(playerId), Filters.or(Icon.EPISODE_I, Icon.EPISODE_VII), Filters.hasAbilityOrHasPermanentPilotWithAbility)) (deploy +2)
Filters.and(Filters.battleground, Filters.occupiesWith(playerId, self, Filters.Phoenix_Squadron_character)) (back destiny mod X)
Filters.battleground (back drain +1 when drained-this-turn flag set)
setupAndPullRoutes: Start of game deploys Lothal system and a Lothal site from Reserve Deck (front:55-72).
Shared pull (same GameTextActionId.ZERO_HOUR__DEPLOY_LOCATION on both sides): once per turn, deploy a Lothal site from Reserve Deck (Filters.Lothal_site) (front:136-155; BACK:58-77).
otherObligations: Front, remainder of game: Menace Fades and Projection Of A Skywalker are canceled (action proxy, front:85-131).
Front, remainder of game: Harc, Jedi (except Ahsoka and Kanan), and your [Episode I]/[Episode VII] cards with ability are deploy +2 (front:77-80).
Back: if you Force drained at a battleground this turn, your other Force drains at battlegrounds are +1 (ForceDrainModifier + InPlayDataEqualsCondition, BACK:52).
Back: once per turn during battle, may add or subtract X from a just-drawn battle destiny (or opponent's weapon destiny), X = battlegrounds you occupy with Phoenix Squadron characters (BACK:80-111).
Back: at Lothal system, number of battle destiny draws may not be limited for either player (BACK:53).
Strategic note from law: staying flipped only requires not falling behind on controlled-Lothal-location count; the 3-location threshold is not re-checked after flipping.

profileGaps: flipGateSite null and no field carries the COUNT (3 Lothal locations); locationFragments ['lothal'] names the family but not the threshold.
